'''Rina Zazkis''' is a Canadian scholar in education and mathematics. She is a professor in the Faculty of Education at [[Simon Fraser University]] and a [[Canada Research Chair]] in STEM Teaching and Learning.

==Career==
Zazkis began her academic career at [[Simon Fraser University]] (SFU) in 1991 as an assistant professor. She was eventually promoted to full professor in the Faculty of Education by 2000.<ref>{{cite web |title=Academic Positions |url=https://www.sfu.ca/education/faculty-profiles/rzazkis/background/positions.html |website=sfu.ca |accessdate=November 4, 2019}}</ref> In 2011, she was a recipient of the Dean of Graduate Studies Awards for Excellence.<ref>{{cite web |title=Faculty members receive Dean of Graduate Studies Awards for Excellence |url=https://www.sfu.ca/education/newsevents/foe-news/2011/october/faculty-members-receive-dean-of-graduate-studies-awards-for-exce.html |website=sfu.ca |accessdate=November 4, 2019 |date=October 31, 2011}}</ref>

In 2017, she was appointed a [[Canada Research Chair]] in STEM Teaching and Learning.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wong |first1=Justin |title=New Canada Research Chair at SFU to bridge education gap between high school and post-secondary mathematics |url=https://www.sfu.ca/sfunews/stories/2017/02/new-canada-research-chair-at-sfu-to-bridge-education-gap-between-high-school-and-post-secondary-mathematics.html |website=sfu.ca |accessdate=November 4, 2019 |date=February 2, 2017}}</ref> Two years later she received the 2019 Partners In Research National Award.<ref>{{cite web |title=2019 Partners In Research National Award Winners |url=http://www.pirweb.org/en/current-partners-in-research-national-award-winners-2/#math |website=pirweb.org |accessdate=November 4, 2019}}</ref>
